# Andy Menutti

> Creative technologist, audio engineer and full-stack & AI developer in Buenos Aires, Argentina (GMT-3, open to remote). 25+ years of sound design and live audio for film, theatre, dance and festivals, now building with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Ruby on Rails and the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs. Selected 1 of 300 from 32,000 applicants for the a16z × Y Combinator × Buildspace builder program (2024). Contact: menuttiandres@gmail.com · WhatsApp +54 11 3455 0050.

Fits: Creative Technologist, audio/music AI engineer, full-stack engineer (TypeScript/React/Next.js/Rails), AI integration engineer (LLM apps, MCP servers), sound designer / audio UX.
